purpose: Give agents, reviewers, tool builders, hardware testers, and infrastructure contributors bounded ways to help AXIOM-MESH without treating technical capability or repository participation as authority.
operator_approval_required_for: deploying or publishing a hosted surface
activating a protocol or production route
testing systems not owned by the contributor or explicitly authorized for disposable testing

lanes.title: Review and falsification
lanes.purpose: Challenge current authority, evidence, trust-boundary, and claim invariants using repository-owned or explicitly disposable environments.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: read-only analysis, issue comments, or non-sensitive red-team reports
required_evidence: exact build, commit, file, artifact, or URL reviewed
expected invariant or claim boundary
minimal safe reproduction or counterexample
supporting non-sensitive evidence

lanes.title: Implementation contribution
lanes.purpose: Propose bounded code, test, documentation, or tooling changes through normal repository review.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: proposal or pull request only; no merge authority
required_evidence: exact base commit and changed scope
tests or verification relevant to the changed claim
explicit statement of any capability or authority impact

lanes.title: Interoperability and adapter work
lanes.purpose: Improve protocol-neutral runtime, adapter, or connector compatibility while preserving the Gateway -> Hypervisor -> Sandbox -> Grid authority path.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: design, fixtures, synthetic conformance, or pull request; no protocol activation
required_evidence: exact external contract or version being modeled
translation and failure semantics
negative tests showing capability or connectivity does not create authority

lanes.title: Hardware validation
lanes.purpose: Run reproducible AXIOM-MESH compatibility, isolation, recovery, performance, or device-integration tests on contributor-owned or explicitly disposable hardware.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: test plan and evidence only; no purchasing, shipping, credential provisioning, or production deployment authority
required_evidence: exact hardware model and relevant firmware or operating-system versions
exact AXIOM-MESH commit or build
test procedure and environment ownership statement
raw non-sensitive results and observed limitations

lanes.title: Infrastructure validation
lanes.purpose: Exercise deployment topology, transport, deny-egress, backup, recovery, resilience, telemetry, or multi-node foundations in contributor-owned or explicitly disposable infrastructure.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: test plan and evidence only; no production deployment, routing, credential, or third-party infrastructure authority
required_evidence: exact topology and environment ownership statement
exact build or commit
preconditions and rollback or cleanup plan
non-sensitive logs, receipts, or measurements

lanes.title: Claim and documentation audit
lanes.purpose: Compare machine discovery, documentation, capability state, release evidence, and public wording for contradictions or overclaim.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: read-only audit, issue, or bounded documentation pull request
required_evidence: exact conflicting claims or artifacts
canonical source that should control the claim
smallest proposed correction or regression

lanes.title: Benchmark and compatibility evidence
lanes.purpose: Produce reproducible performance, resource, operating-system, runtime, or device-compatibility evidence scoped to the exact tested environment.
lanes.default_effect_boundary: benchmark plan, data, or pull request; no certification or general performance claim
required_evidence: exact hardware, software, and environment
exact build or commit
methodology and repeated measurements where practical
limitations and conditions under which the result should not be generalized

nonclaims: A contribution lane is an intake and collaboration boundary, not permission to execute AXIOM-MESH effects or modify protected repository state.
Hardware and infrastructure lanes do not authorize third-party testing, purchases, shipping, credential exchange, or production deployment.
A benchmark, synthetic conformance result, test report, pull request, review, or green workflow is not a security certification or production-promotion decision.
Repository participation does not grant merge authority, runtime authority, protocol activation, or deployment authority.
